SELECT FROM material m LEFT JOIN position p ON p.id = m.position_id AND p.deleted = 0 WHERE m.deleted = 0 AND m.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM dept_position dp WHERE dp.position_id = m.position_id AND dp.status = 1 AND dp.dept_id = #{deptId} ) ORDER BY m.create_time DESC, m.id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO material (material_name, material_type, position_id, summary, file_url, version_no, is_public, status, create_by, create_time, update_time, deleted) VALUES (#{materialName}, #{materialType}, #{positionId}, #{summary}, #{fileUrl}, #{versionNo}, #{isPublic}, #{status}, #{createBy}, NOW(), NOW(), 0)
mapper.update:
UPDATE material
material_name = #{materialName}, material_type = #{materialType}, position_id = #{positionId}, summary = #{summary}, file_url = #{fileUrl}, version_no = #{versionNo}, is_public = #{isPublic}, status = #{status}, update_time = NOW()
WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
